## Harley-Davidson, Inc. Declares Dividend


09/03/2026


Download (opens in new window)


MILWAUKEE


, Sept. 3, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- The Harley-Davidson, Inc. (NYSE: HOG) Board of Directors has approved a cash dividend of $0.1875 per share for the third quarter of 2026. The dividend is payable September 29, 2026 to the shareholders of record of the Company's common stock as of September 15, 2026.


Harley-Davidson, Inc. is the parent company of Harley-Davidson Motor Company and Harley-Davidson Financial Services.
